description:
What You Will Own 

 
 Training Content Creation - Design and develop structured training modules, courses, and certification paths covering product functionality, deployment scenarios, and troubleshooting. Build assessments and quizzes that validate learner comprehension at each stage. Your content will serve multiple audiences: sales teams who need to position and sell the portfolio, engineering and support teams who need technical depth, and customers and channel partners who need to deploy and operate our solutions confidently.

 Product Learning and Collaboration - Become a product expert through hands-on lab work. Set up, configure, and operate Black Box solutions to build the depth of understanding required to teach others effectively. Work closely with product management and marketing to receive use cases, deployment scenarios, and market context, and ensure training content aligns with product launches, positioning, and go-to-market priorities.

 AI-Powered Content Development - Leverage AI tools for presentation, video production, and course delivery. Use platforms such as Synthesia, ElevenLabs, and similar technologies to create scalable, professional training content efficiently. Stay current with emerging AI capabilities and continuously evaluate how they can improve content quality and production speed.

 Content Standards and Framework - Establish the templates, formats, and quality standards that will scale as the training function grows. Document your methodology to ensure consistency and repeatability across all training content.

 Continuous Improvement Keep training content current as products evolve. Incorporate new features, firmware updates, and market feedback into existing materials on an ongoing basis.

 
 What You Must Know 

 
 AV/IT or KVM technologies: familiarity with video extension, switching, signal distribution, or related infrastructure technologies

 Instructional design fundamentals: how to structure a curriculum, sequence learning objectives, and build effective assessments

 Content development tools: experience with e-learning authoring platforms (Articulate, Captivate, or similar), video production, and LMS administration

 Technical self-sufficiency: ability to work independently in a lab environment, follow technical documentation, and learn complex hardware and software products without hand-holding

 
 Qualifications 

 Required: 

 
 5-7 years of experience in technical training content development, instructional design, or technical writing for hardware or infrastructure products

 Demonstrated ability to take a complex technical product and break it down into clear, structured learning paths

 Experience creating training content for both technical and non-technical audiences

 Hands-on experience with lab environments and test equipment

 Experience building a training program or content library from scratch

 Strong written and verbal English communication skills

 
 Strongly preferred: 

 
 Hands-on experience using AI-powered tools for content creation, video production, or course delivery (Synthesia, ElevenLabs, or similar)

 Experience in the AV, KVM, broadcast, or IT infrastructure industry

 
 Valued but not required: 

 
 Familiarity with video processing, signal distribution, or networked AV technologies

 
 Education 

 
 Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or educational field

 
 Who Thrives Here

 You are curious and self-directed. When handed a product you have never seen before, your instinct is to plug it in, explore every feature, and then figure out how to teach it. You do not wait for someone to walk you through every feature. You build your own understanding and turn it into content that makes complex technology accessible. You are comfortable operating as the first training hire, which means defining your own priorities and building structure where none exists today.
